description: Free, no signup: shares posture_preview's 60-calls-per-hour budget across all callers. Returns live RFC 9309 allow/disallow decisions for a fixed, versioned sample of up to 24 public origins, computed from each origin's own robots.txt. A robots.txt that cannot be read is reported as unknown, never as allowed. Argument: limit (optional, 1-24, default all origins in the seed). The HTTP equivalent is GET /v1/agents/policy (add ?format=csv for CSV). For a single page's full access-posture report, use the paid tool page_posture ($0.01).

limit.description: How many origins of the fixed seed to include, 1-24 (default: all of them). The seed list is versioned and published with the dataset.
limit.title: Limit
